name: @pipeworx/mcp-ror

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Research Organization Registry (ROR) for universities, research institutes, hospitals, companies, and funders by name or acronym, with optional filters for organization type (education, healthcare, company, government, nonprofit, facility, archive, other) and ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code. Returns each organization ROR id, official and alternate names, country and location, types, and external identifiers. Answers which ROR id belongs to a named research institution.

type.description: education | healthcare | company | archive | nonprofit | government | facility | other

tools.name: get
tools.description: Full ROR record. Accepts the trailing identifier (e.g. "03vek6s52") or the full URL.

tools.name: affiliation
tools.description: Fuzzy affiliation-string match. Returns candidates with confidence scores.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ror forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ror pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
